summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload under CKEditor impersonation
details: Package impersonates @ckeditor/ckeditor5-build-classic (identical name suffix, author, homepage, keywords, and files copied from the legitimate CKSource build) but adds a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and uses it (or a locally installed bun) to execFileSync a sibling file math_init.js with cwd set to the package directory. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-bundled file (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) whose contents are obfuscated with a shuffled numeric/string constant array plus a rotator function (WV8StW) and `_0x`-style identifiers, designed to run only under the alien Bun interpreter dropped by preinstall. A CKEditor front-end build has no legitimate need for Bun, a preinstall hook, or a 727KB obfuscated binary blob. The use of an alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated payload at install time evades Node-based analysis and delivers attacker-controlled code execution on any machine that runs `npm install` of this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
